reasoning: As of October 16, 2025, Tesla has released FSD V14/V14.1, but all evidence indicates it remains a SUPERVISED system requiring human oversight. Multiple sources confirm: (1) FSD V14.1 is explicitly labeled 'FSD (Supervised)' with safety protocols requiring driver monitoring; (2) Official documentation still mandates human supervision despite functional improvements; (3) NHTSA opened an investigation on October 9 into safety violations, indicating the system is not yet deemed safe for unsupervised operation; (4) Tesla's limited robotaxi pilot in Austin still requires a safety operator present. While V14 shows dramatic improvements and Musk claims it 'feels alive,' no source indicates Tesla has released an unsupervised FSD meeting all three resolution criteria (no supervision requirement, public roads without driver present, broad accessibility). With only 15 days remaining until October 31, and no announcement of unsupervised FSD launch, resolution appears unlikely.
